correctness.rationale: Each interior trinomial factor L+Tw+Ww² is Hurwitz stable; strict Hermite–Biehler gives real-negative simple interlaced roots of even P(z),odd Q(z). Positive Q/P residues provide an exact convex mixture of single-Bernoulli deletions from normalized P. A convolution/unimodality lemma localizes all deletion modes in [a-1,b], hence mixture modes too. Boundary probabilities follow compact coefficient/deletion-mixture limiting argument without assuming modes continuous. Sharp n=2 polynomial [0,1,3,1,3]/8 yields modes E={1,2} and odd indices {0,1}, distance 3/2. Independent quarter-probability exhaustive grids for n=1..4 counted 9,189,3159,49329 admissible cases, zero violations, sharp doubled gaps 1,3,3,3. General n proved analytically, not by grid.
